tidy.hint: Merges and sorts what agents learned here. It runs in the background.
flush.hint: Saves what agents have just learned to the store.
erase.hint: Removes everything stored for this project. This cannot be undone.
waiting: A change is waiting to be checked. Check it, or stop tracking it, first.
tidy.title: Tidy up memory for {{name}}?
tidy.effect1: Merges and sorts what agents learned in this project, in realm {{realm}}.
tidy.effect2: It makes several AI model calls and reorganises memory. That cannot be undone.
tidy.effect3: It runs in the background. A successful answer means it is queued, not finished.
tidy.held: Asking memory to tidy up {{name}} may have gone through. Check again reads the tidy-up status; nothing is sent again.
tidy.heldNoStatus: This agent does not report tidy-up progress, so Check again may not settle it. Stop tracking ends the wait.
tidy.status.other: A tidy-up of another project is {{state}}.
erase.title: Erase all memory for {{name}}?
erase.effect1: Everything stored for this project in realm {{realm}} is removed: memories, lessons, slots, observations, summaries and the links between them.
erase.effect2: This cannot be undone. Other projects and other realms are untouched.
erase.effect3: A record that an erasure happened is kept. It holds counts, never content.
erase.held: Erasing {{name}} may have gone through. Check again reads the project list; nothing is sent again.
flush.pending: Writing pending memory may not have finished, or only some of it did. To run it again, choose Write pending memory now from Manage memory.
act.refused.write_intent_invalid: The agent did not accept this request: its one-time permission had expired or been used. Nothing was changed. Try again.
act.refused.realm_mismatch: The agent now works in a different realm than the one shown. Nothing was changed.
act.refused.store_unavailable: Memory for this realm is not available on this computer right now. Nothing was changed.
act.refused.service_unavailable: Memory for this realm is not connected on this computer right now. Nothing was changed.
act.refused.consolidate_unavailable: Memory is off or the tidy-up queue is full. Nothing was queued. Try again shortly.
act.refused.refused_realm_changed: The agent's realm changed, or this is not its realm. Nothing was changed.
act.refused.admin_unauthorized: The agent's admin check refused this. Nothing was changed.
host.title: Use {{computer}} as realm {{realm}}'s memory host?
host.effect1: Makes this computer the host that serves realm {{realm}}'s memory.
host.effect2: Use it when no computer is serving the realm's memory.
host.note: It does not copy or move any memory from another computer.
host.held: Choosing {{computer}} as the memory host may have gone through. Check again reads the realm's hosts; nothing is sent again.
stop.title: Stop tracking this change?
stop.effect: It may still have gone through. Read the memory again before you change it.
